const values: (string | number | null)[] = [1, "a", null];

const twoReturns = values.filter((x) => {
  if (x === null) return false;
  return typeof x === "string";
});
twoReturns[0].toUpperCase();

const mutableAlias = values.filter((x) => {
  let isText = typeof x === "string";
  return isText;
});
mutableAlias[0].toUpperCase();

const implicitEnd = values.filter((x) => {
  if (x !== null) {
    return typeof x === "string";
  }
});
implicitEnd[0].toUpperCase();

const reassigned = values.filter((x) => {
  x = x ?? "none";
  return typeof x === "string";
});
reassigned[0].toUpperCase();
